params.name: team_id
params.description: Team or organization ID to export. Required for API-key integrations. Usage Metrics shows a prefilled request for the current organization.

params.name: period
params.description: Relative date range to export when start_date and end_date are omitted.

params.name: start_date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be provided together with end_date; takes precedence over period.

params.name: end_date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be provided together with start_date; takes precedence over period.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone used to resolve relative periods and day boundaries.

params.name: report
params.description: CSV only. summary exports per-member totals; daily exports member usage by day.

params.name: group_by
params.description: JSON only. Add platform usage breakdowns to the response.

items.docs: Export team usage metrics as JSON or CSV. Usage Metrics in Shortcut provides a prefilled request with your team_id; use these query parameters to customize the date range, output format, and optional platform grouping. API keys must belong to a user with usage metrics access for the requested team or organization.
